The main takeaway from our work is that
the raw accuracy of a classifier is a good indication of its fitness.
it is possible to improve the performance of XCS by using the raw classifier accuracy in the computation of classifier reproduction and deletion probabilities.
, in XCS and in other classifier systems, the use of raw classifier accuracy can be beneficial to improve the performance of the system and to better understand its behavior.
